title.zh: 在莱特省比利兰分省Cabucgayan市镇设立国立工艺学校，名称为Cabucgayan国立工艺学校，并授权为此拨款的法案
title.en: An Act to Establish a National School of Arts and Trades in the Municipality of Cabucgayan, Sub-Province of Biliran, Province of Leyte, to be Known as Cabucgayan National School of Arts and Trades, and to Authorize the Appropriation of Funds Therefor

title.vi: Đạo luật thành lập Trường Nghệ thuật và Thương mại Quốc gia tại Đô thị Cabucgayan, Tỉnh Biliran, Tỉnh Leyte với tên gọi Trường Nghệ thuật và Thương mại Cabucgayan Quốc gia, và phân bổ kinh phí cho mục đích này
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติจัดตั้งโรงเรียนศิลปะและหัตถกรรมแห่งชาติ ในเทศบาล Cabucgayan จังหวัด Biliran จังหวัด Leyte ในชื่อ โรงเรียนศิลปะและหัตถกรรม Cabucgayan แห่งชาติ และจัดสรรเงินทุนสำหรับการนี้
title.id: Undang-Undang membentuk Sekolah Seni dan Keterampilan Nasional di Kotamadya Cabucgayan, Provinsi Biliran, Provinsi Leyte dengan nama Sekolah Seni dan Keterampilan Cabucgayan Nasional, dan mengalokasikan dana untuk itu
title.ms: Akta menubuhkan Sekolah Seni dan Pertukangan Kebangsaan di Perbandaran Cabucgayan, Wilayah Biliran, Wilayah Leyte dengan nama Sekolah Seni dan Pertukangan Cabucgayan Kebangsaan, dan memperuntukkan dana untuk itu

text.en: There is hereby established a national school of arts and trades in the Municipality of Cabucgayan, Sub-Province of Biliran, Province of Leyte, to be known as Cabucgayan National School of Arts and Trades.

The Secretary of Education is authorized to organize the curricular instruction in said school and he shall have the power to issue rules and regulations as may be necessary to carry out the purpose of this Act.

The sum of two hundred thousand pesos is hereby authorized to be appropriated out of any funds in the National Treasury not otherwise appropriated, for the establishment, operation and maintenance of said school during the fiscal year nineteen hundred sixty-six. Thereafter, the sums necessary therefor shall be included in the annual General Appropriations Act.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: June 19, 1965.
